notes.content: Minimum grade of c- in major courses
Students must earn a minimum grade of C- in all courses taken to fulfill the major requirements; and must earn a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 in the major.

notes.content: Admission requirement modifications for Engineering Majors: transfer applicants in this major are not required to complete CSU-GE area A3 Critical Thinking as part of the admission requirements. General Education for Engineering Majors: click here for modifications to general education requirements. Additional grade and repeat information for ERE Majors: Grades of D, D+, F, WU, and NC count as failed attempts. Required courses in the major may not be repeated more than one time. If a student has two failed attempts in a required course, the student will not be able to graduate with an ERE degree.

notes.content: This major requires calculus (MATH 105 and/or MATH 109 as shown below). To enroll in calculus, students must meet the prerequisite which is pre-calculus (MATH 102 or both MATH 101+101T) or the equivalent. Check the Calculus Prerequisite Courses section below to view details on recommended preparation.
